name: Quot.liftEq
statement:
lemma Quot.liftEq {α β} [s : Setoid α] (f g : Quotient s → β) (h : f ∘ (⟦.⟧) = g ∘ (⟦.⟧)) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  refine funext fun x => ?_
  let ⟨ x_bar, eq_x ⟩ := Quotient.exists_rep x
  exact eq_x ▸ congrFun h x_bar

name: Or.assoc2
statement: theorem Or.assoc2 (h : (p1 ∨ p2) ∨ q) : p1 ∨ p2 ∨ q

name: TestAllSplits'.succ
statement:
theorem TestAllSplits'.succ {i j P}
    (h1 : TestAllSplits' i (j+1) P) (h2 : P i (j+1)) : TestAllSplits' (i+1) j P
proof:
:= by
  simp only [TestAllSplits', Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq, or_imp, forall_and, forall_eq,
    Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] at *
  exact ⟨fun i' h => by convert h1 i' h using 1; omega, h2⟩
context:
import Tengoku.All

set_option linter.all false

def TestAllSplits' (i j : Nat) (P : Nat → Nat → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∀ i' < i, P i' (j + (i - i'))
